elo.translation: abbr. elocution 演说术; 朗诵法; eloquence 雄辩; 口才

elocular.definition:
a. Having but one cell, or cavity; not divided by a septum
   or partition.

elocute.definition: v declaim in an elocutionary manner
elocute.translation:
vi.作慷慨激昂的演说,朗诵 
vt.慷慨激昂地讲出, 朗读出

elocution.definition: n. an expert manner of speaking involving control of voice and gesture
elocution.translation: n. 雄辩术, 演说法

elocutionary.definition:
a. of or relating to elocution
s. (used of style of speaking) overly embellished
elocutionary.translation: a. 雄辩术的, 演说法的

elocutionist.definition: n. a public speaker trained in voice production and gesture and delivery
elocutionist.translation: n. 雄辩家, 演说家

elodea canadensis.translation: [网络] 伊乐藻；沉水植物伊乐藻；加拿大伊乐藻

elodea densa.translation: [网络] 伊乐藻；水蕴草；伊勒藻

elohim.definition:
n. One of the principal names by which God is designated in
   the Hebrew Scriptures.

elohist.definition:
n. The writer, or one of the writers, of the passages of the
   Old Testament, notably those of Elohim instead of Jehovah, as the name
   of the Supreme Being; -- distinguished from Jehovist.
elohist.translation: n. <希伯来>埃洛希姆派(在希伯来文《旧约》中某些章节称上帝为埃洛希姆而不称为耶和华的无名氏作者)

elohistic.definition:
a. Relating to Elohim as a name of God; -- said of passages
   in the Old Testament.

eloi.translation: abbr. emergency letter of instructions 紧急函令，紧急事件指令信

eloign.definition:
v. t. To remove afar off; to withdraw.
v. t. To convey to a distance, or beyond the jurisdiction, or
   to conceal, as goods liable to distress.
eloign.translation: v. 把...移至远处, 带走(财物)

eloigned.translation: v. 把…移至远处, 带走（财物）( eloign的过去式和过去分词 )

eloigning.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Eloign
eloigning.translation: v. 把…移至远处, 带走（财物）( eloign的现在分词 )

eloignment.definition: n. Removal to a distance; withdrawal.

eloin.translation:
vt. 运走, 拿走, 带走(财物)；把…移至远处；[古语]使自己远离, 把(自己)迁至远处；使(自己)隐藏起来
n. 【法律】(行政司法官所作的)应扣押抵债的财物已被转移至管辖范围之外的批复

eloisa.translation: [女子名] 埃洛伊萨 Heloise的变体

eloise.translation: abbr. 欧洲太阳实验大型轨道仪器（European Large Orbiting Instrumentation for Solar Experiments）

elon.translation: n. 埃伦（可溶性显影剂粉末）

elong.definition:
v. t. To lengthen out; to prolong.
v. t. To put away; to separate; to keep off.

elongate.definition:
v. make long or longer by pulling and stretching
s. having notably more length than width; being long and slender
elongate.translation:
v. 延长, (使)伸延
a. 伸长的

elongated.definition: s. drawn out or made longer spatially
elongated.translation: v. 延长, 加长( elongate的过去式和过去分词 )

elongates.definition: v make long or longer by pulling and stretching
elongates.translation: v. 延长, 加长( elongate的第三人称单数 )

elongating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Elongate
elongating.translation: v. 延长, 加长( elongate的现在分词 )

elongation.definition:
n. the quality of being elongated
n. an addition to the length of something
n. the act of lengthening something
elongation.translation:
n. 伸长, 延长, 延伸率
[化] 伸长; 伸长率

elongationpercentage.translation: [机] 伸长, 伸长百分比

elongations.definition:
n. the quality of being elongated
n. an addition to the length of something
n. the act of lengthening something
elongations.translation: n. 延长( elongation的复数形式 ); 延长线; <机>延伸率; <天>距（角）

elope.definition: v. run away secretly with one's beloved
elope.translation:
vi. 私奔, 潜逃
[法] 私奔, 弃职, 逃亡

eloped.translation: v. 私奔( elope的过去式和过去分词 )

elopement.definition: n. the act of running away with a lover (usually to get married)
elopement.translation:
n. 潜逃, 私奔
[法] 私奔, 逃亡, 出走

elopements.definition: n. the act of running away with a lover (usually to get married)
elopements.translation: n. 潜逃, 私奔( elopement的复数形式 )

elopes.definition: v. run away secretly with one's beloved

eloping.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Elope
eloping.translation: v. 私奔( elope的现在分词 )

elops.definition:
n. A genus of fishes. See Saury.
n. A mythical serpent.

eloquence.translation:
n. 口才, 雄辩术, 雄辩
[法] 善辩, 口才

eloquent.definition: s. expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
eloquent.translation: a. 雄辩的, 有口才的, 有说服力的

eloquently.translation: adv. 善辩地；富于表现力地

elorine.translation: [医] 艾洛林(副交感神经阻滞药)
